title: reliab findings
description: What an external adapter writes for a command with format: findings. The file is the whole result: reliab does not consult the command's exit code once it parses. See knowledge/decisions/external-adapters.md.

mutants.description: For a mutation tool: how many mutants it tested, so a report can say tested, killed, and survived, not only list survivors.

mutantFiles.description: The mutant counts per repo-relative file, so a baseline scope can be scored.

findings.description: Empty when the tool found nothing.

test.description: What failed, and the finding's identity: the same failure must get the same test across runs so classifications carry forward. Unique within the file.

replay.description: Path of the saved seed or input that reproduces it.
